text: MessageWindowController routes Undo/Redo enabled checks through SetupUndoRedoCommand, rechecks isCommandEnabled in doCommand for shortcuts, then calls the most recent main window messenger with optional chaining. Keep keyboard and menu execution tied to the same availability check. No standalone window, keyboard or transaction execution was run, and a window change between checks was not tested. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Standalone message commands recheck enabled state before undo execution
